facts.business: Sandhar Technologies Limited manufactures and supplies automotive components including locking systems, mirrors, operator cabins, aluminium components, precision assemblies, sheet metal, and steel wheels for diverse mobility segments.
key_risks: Credit risk from customer concentration (some customers >10% of receivables)
facts.related_party_note: The Company provides financial guarantees only for subsidiaries and joint ventures. At 31 March 2026 and 2025, the Company has issued guarantees to certain banks in respect of credit facilities granted to subsidiaries and joint ventures.
